description: Copy templates from a bundled pack into the organization's template library as ordinary templates with a first version; each records the pack, version, slug, content hash, license and authors it came from. Pass the pack id and the template slugs. A template already installed from the same pack is reported as such and not copied again, so a request that failed part way through can simply be repeated. Owners and admins only.

templateSlugs.description: Slugs of the pack templates to copy into the organization's library
